title: Admin inviter can mint admin-role invitations; owner-only promotion unenforced
description: Files: python/src/lichen/group_membership.py:140-141 (can_invite ignores requested role), groups_invite.py:54 (no role context), groups_collection.py:339-341 (role stored verbatim), :546-549 (_join_key auto-appends invitee to admins[]). Chain: admin sends signed invitation role=admin -> invitee becomes admin. Spec/12-apps.md:1129-1143 reserves promotion to owner exclusively (can_remove correctly implements analogous rule; can_invite does not). Test enshrines owner-issued case only. Fix: plumb requested role through can_invite enforcing owner-minted admin invites; negative test.
close_reason: Fixed: GroupRoster.can_invite now takes requested_role (admin mints member-role only; admin-role invitations owner-only per spec 18.8.2 L1129-1143); groups_invite passes invitation.role through the gate; join_key promotion therefore only ever sees roles minted by authorized inviters. Tests: test_groups_invite.py::test_admin_may_only_mint_admin_invitations end-to-end (admin-minted-admin 4.03, admin-minted-member accepted + joins as member-only), test_owner_minted_admin_invitation_joins_as_admin (owner invite promotes via join_key), plus unit matrix in tests/test_group_membership.py::test_roster_authority.
